notes.title: Tobe's Vertical Adventure Updated
notes.notes:
Update Includes:
- Resolution Setting : If there's a problem with the resolution detection, you can set your preferred resolution instead. Right click to access the properties, select "set launch option" and key in "-res1280x720". The 2 set of digits can be replace and stands for the length and width respectively.

- Screen off center fixed.

- Reduced the lag issue on rope climbing and wall slide.

- Improved the minimum screen size limit.

- Key configuration option improved to give player more feedback and confirmation.

notes.title: Tobe's Vertical Adventure Updated
notes.notes:
Reported Crash Fixed
  • Resolution : Resolution smaller than 1280 x 720 should now work
  • Disconnected Joypad : Game no longer crash when joypads are removed, but automatically switch to keyboard controls instead.
  • System.IO.FileNotFoundException: Could not find file : Fixed!
  • System.ArgumentNullException: Buffer cannot be null : Go to Steam Libary, right click on Tobe's Vertical Adventure, select properties, and SET LAUNCH OPTIONS. Type in "-disableleaderboard" (without quotes).

Fixs, Tweaks & Updates
  • Volume control added
  • Time taken to escape is now shown in level select for all you overachiever
  • Key configuration : Clearer indication of the key you're currently configurating, confirmation of key change and option to change back to default settings.
  • Key configuration : Clearer indication when player try to use a key that's already in use
  • Joypad : Player 2 can use joypad while player 1 is uses his keyboard and vice versa
  • Reading Sign : We fixed the stupid error we created (d'oh!)

notes.title: Tobe's Vertical Adventure Updated
notes.notes:
If you tried the game, tell us about it! Write us a review in our user forum, and tell us what you think about it. What are the hit and miss? What do you want to see in future games? How would you have done it? We have 3 physical edition to give away to the top 3 user reviews.
Write us a review now! http://forums.steampowered.com/forums/showthread.php?t=2012056



Reported Crash Fixed
  • If you're having issue with the game's resolution or cropped visual, you can still play the game in window mode. Go to Tobe's Vertical Adventure on Steam, right click to select launch option and type in "-window".
  • Incompatible controller causing crash on startup: System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException: Index was out of range. Must be non-negative and less than the size of the collection.
  • System.ArgumentException: Texture width or height is larger than the device supports.
  • System.InvalidOperationException: An invalid operation was performed. Is your PlayerIndex correct?

Fixs, Tweaks & Updates
  • Leaderboard crash
  • Leaderboard name cap
  • Speed run achievements fixed
  • 2nd player can use joypad while player 1 uses keyboard
  • Both player can use joypad at the same time
  • Incompatible controller will now be disabled instead of causing the game to crash
  • Xbox 360 joypad trigger buttons are set to "run" by default
  • Default joypad layout now register "Button 8" as pause to match Xbox Controller
  • If joypad do not have have "Button 8", the last button will be set to pause.
  • Pressing dpad in menu will not move twice at once
  • Escape time is now reported at the end of each act in level select
  • Windows mode can be selected from steam (Right click on Tobe'sVA in Steam > launch option and type in "
  • window")
  • Enter and Esc now works as "Yes" and "No" respectively in menu
  • Esc can be used to pause the game
  • Co
  • op mode, Nana's treasure collected are calculated in the game's total score

notes.title: Now Available: Tobe's Vertical Adventure
notes.notes:
Tobe's Vertical Adventure is Now Available and is 10% off until July 25th 10AM PST.

Tobe's Vertical Adventure is an indie, retro, platformer starring Tobe, the overly devoted gamer who's been forced on a treasure hunt by his materialistic crush, Nana. The big headed duo will travel back and forth in the crumbling caves in search of treasures while rescuing fluffy animals, making you scream kawaii ne~ along the way. With 2 unique characters and a total of 4 islands and 16 levels to explore, Tobe's Vertical Adventure shall bring you back to the 16-bit era.
